capabilities: Copy the whole note or a selection as Medium- or Substack-ready HTML to the clipboard
Copy notes as cleaned Markdown with Obsidian syntax stripped
Convert 56 Obsidian elements, including callouts, tables, footnotes, and embeds
Embed local images as base64 and render LaTeX math via KaTeX
Configure stripping of frontmatter, tags, and wikilinks and Medium table handling
extras: README includes a privacy section explaining the community store's generic "Clipboard Access" label and stating the plugin only writes to the clipboard and makes no network requests.
problem: Pasting Obsidian notes into Medium or Substack loses formatting because Obsidian-specific syntax (wikilinks, callouts, highlights, embeds) is not valid there.
summary: Clipboard exporter that converts notes to platform-optimized HTML for pasting into Medium and Substack, plus a cleaned-Markdown option.
